body.intent: Fix A Go build inside a run step fails when its $WORK temp folder vanishes mid-build, and the run ends: plan run 01M6W7G5J0M6 (change set 01M6W7G8YBXB) failed at step rebase on 2026-11-08 ~00:15Z with 'could not import io (open $WORK/b033/_pkg_.a: no such file or directory)' for many std packages while ~5 agents built and tested on the 4-core VM (load 28). The daemon's go build sweep (gosweep, TempMaxAge 2h) logged nothing in that window, so something else removed a live ~/tmp/go-build* folder: find what (candidates: a test's TestMain or tmpsweep removing TMPDIR entries by prefix, an agent's cleanup, go's own cleanup under a shared TMPDIR) and stop it. Also: a step whose command fails with this signature should retry once instead of ending the run. Unstuck by rhiza run resume --retry 01M6W7G5J0M6.
